capabilities.justification: Reads the agent executable's ELF program headers to find its interpreter (PT_INTERP), which the Landlock ruleset must allow.

capabilities.target: libc syscall landlock_create_ruleset, landlock_add_rule, openat2, open, fstat, read, fcntl, socketpair, recvmsg, poll and the seccomp notification ioctls in the parent; prctl, open, getdents64, fcntl, landlock_restrict_self, seccomp, sendmsg, readlinkat, close, dup2, _exit and execveat in the forked child before exec
capabilities.justification: Builds a Landlock ruleset and a seccomp-BPF program for an agent, and installs both, with no_new_privs, between fork and exec (D18S build step 4). For a broker it also places the inherited key descriptors at 3..3+n just before the one exec (P2.6d-3). Neither has a safe std API.

justification: The D18S Linux applier. The unsafe syscalls and the pre_exec hook live here, so the supervisor crates keep forbid(unsafe_code).
